options.name: label
options.description: Visible label and accessible name.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the label; it remains the accessible name.

options.name: value
options.description: Initial value; also the value restored by reset().

options.name: name
options.description: Form field name.

options.name: placeholder
options.description: Supplementary hint; never replaces the label.

options.name: description
options.description: Help text referenced by aria-describedby.

options.name: required
options.description: Empty value is invalid; shows the required indicator.

options.name: disabled
options.description: Disables the textarea.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Value is focusable and submitted but not editable.

options.name: minLength
options.description: Minimum length in code points.

options.name: maxLength
options.description: Maximum length in code points (validated, not truncated).

options.name: showCounter
options.description: Show remaining/over characters; requires maxLength.

options.name: rows
options.description: Visible text rows, integer 1..100; the minimum height for resize 'auto'.

options.name: resize
options.description: Native vertical resize handle, fixed height, or grow with content.

options.name: maxRows
options.description: Upper bound in rows for resize 'auto' (integer >= rows); content scrolls beyond it.

options.name: autocomplete
options.description: Native autocomplete token.

options.name: spellcheck
options.description: Native spellcheck.

options.name: validate
options.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

options.name: icons
options.description: Icon slot overrides.

options.name: validationTiming
options.description: When validation messages first appear; afterwards they update live.

options.name: locale
options.description: Message and number-formatting locale.

properties.name: host
properties.description: Consumer host; its children are owned by the component.

properties.name: validity
properties.description: { valid, error, message }; computed on every change.

properties.name: dirty
properties.description: Value differs from the initial value.

properties.name: touched
properties.description: Focus has left the control at least once.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Programmatic value (no events); clears an external custom error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule); cleared when the user edits.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear dirty/touched/submitted state.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, listeners, registration, and subscriptions.

events.name: aui-change
events.description: User committed the value (native change, on blur).

cssClasses.name: aui-textarea--resize-none | --auto | --auto-native
cssClasses.description: Sizing modifiers on the host (--auto-native: field-sizing: content is used).

cssClasses.name: aui-textarea__input
cssClasses.description: Native textarea; also the control boundary.
